subject: general
question: Which of the following is the oldest dated forts in India, as first mentioned in Alexander the Great's war records, bringing it to the 4th century BCE?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kangra Fort**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kangra Fort** is considered one of the oldest forts in India, with its origins dating back to the **4th century BCE**.
 
• The fort was mentioned in the war records of **Alexander the Great**, indicating its historical significance during his invasion of India.
 
• Located in **Kangra, Himachal Pradesh**, the fort stands as an emblem of the **Trigarta Kingdom**, which was one of the oldest kingdoms in India.
 
• The fort has witnessed numerous invasions, including attacks by **Mahmud of Ghazni** in the 11th century and **Feroz Shah Tughlaq** in the 14th century.
 
• Its strategic location near the confluence of the **Banganga and Manjhi Rivers** made it a critical stronghold in ancient and medieval India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trigarta Kingdom:**

 
 
• An ancient kingdom mentioned in the Mahabharata, it was known for its warrior clans and strategic location in the Himalayan region.
 
• The Kangra Fort was the capital of this kingdom, serving as a vital center of power.
 
 
 
• **Alexander’s Invasion of India:**
 
 
• Alexander the Great invaded India in 326 BCE, and his records provide valuable historical insights into the Indian subcontinent during that era.
 
• The mention of Kangra Fort in his war records highlights its prominence even during ancient times.
 
 
 
• **Architecture of Kangra Fort:**
 
 
• The fort is renowned for its massive stone walls and intricate gateways, showcasing ancient Indian military architecture.
 
• It houses temples and palaces, including the **Ambika Devi Temple**, reflecting its cultural and religious significance.
 
 
 
• **Other Ancient Forts in India:**
 
 
• **Gwalior Fort:** Known for its historical importance and architectural brilliance, but built later around the 6th century CE.
 
• **Kumbhalgarh Fort:** Constructed in the 15th century by Rana Kumbha in Rajasthan, famous for its massive walls.
 
• **Mehrangarh Fort:** Built in 1459 by Rao Jodha in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, it is one of the largest forts in India.
